description: This file defines the DeprecatedTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing the 'deprecated' tag in templates, which marks sections as deprecated.

classes.name: DeprecatedTokenParser
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractTokenParser that handles parsing of the 'deprecated' tag within Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'deprecated' tag, extracting expression and optional parameters, returning a DeprecatedNode.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'deprecated', identifying this parser's associated tag.
